description: Canonical registry of standard Account Data key patterns. Account Data is actor/private state written through ak.account_data.set unless a row explicitly lists another actor-private event kind. Every row MUST declare its cross-device merge primitive (merge_strategy) and delete semantics (deletion_mode); see spec/v1/zh/models/account-data.md section 5.
registry_rules: merge_strategy is the machine-readable cross-device convergence primitive for the key. v1 defines exactly one value, cas_register: the key is a server-versioned compare-and-set whole-value register, every write carries expected_revision and the accepted revision is expected_revision + 1. There is no implicit default; a row without merge_strategy is invalid.

Adding an uncoordinated merge primitive requires a new merge_strategy value plus, on the same row, its comparison transcript, tombstone rule and an active conformance vector. Domain rules such as HLC last-writer-wins or delete-wins run inside the client's compare-and-set retry loop over decrypted plaintext; the server sees only opaque bytes and MUST NOT be asked to merge them.

deletion_mode declares how a key stops holding a live value. physical_delete uses ak.self.account_data.resource.delete, which stores a versioned tombstone and MAY garbage-collect it later; the per-key revision high-water mark is retained forever so a stale write can never resurrect a deleted value. value_tombstone means the deleted state is itself a value written through ak.account_data.set and MUST NOT be physically deleted, because the domain requires an unrevivable terminal state that stays observable after tombstone GC.

account_data_key_patterns.description: Private per-Realm tags and ordering hints.
Principal-private notification and push rule configuration.
Principal-private do-not-disturb schedule used by notification routing.
Principal-private custom emoji and sticker collection metadata.
Private client UI state such as sidebar, recent realms (canonical key recent_realms), language, and layout preferences.
Holder-private personal blocklist. It affects only the holder's local projection, notifications, contact handling, and trusted holder-side filtering.
Private local remark, note, tag, and pin metadata for an actor, organization, device, or service DID.
Private local remark, note, tag, and pin metadata for a Realm.

Principal-private sender-side presence visibility policy. Sync services MUST NOT project or read presence_visibility; encrypted Signal fanout is selected by the sender according to profiles-presence.md section 3.4.

Principal-private manual presence preference: pinned manual_state (online/idle/dnd), temporary status_message override, and clears_at expiry. Enforced client-side at send time across all of the principal's devices; services MUST NOT require plaintext or a projection of this key and MUST NOT treat it as a policy projection surface.
Private read-receipt send/display defaults and per-Realm or per-Strand overrides.
Principal-private reminders keyed by opaque id; target_ref and note remain inside encrypted value.

Principal-private scheduled-send plan. The UUIDv7 in planned_message_id is retyped as the eventual ak.message.create Event.event_id; message_payload omits message_id and the reducer retypes the Event UUID back into Message.id.
Principal-private snooze state keyed by HMAC-derived target_key.
Principal-private saved item in an HMAC-derived collection; each item is an independent account-data value.
Principal-private cross-device draft sync key. Raw target_ref MUST NOT appear in the account-data key.

Principal-private cross-device file transfer record keyed by an HMAC-derived transfer_key. Blob bytes are stored through ak.self.blob.*; raw blob_ref, filename, target device ids, and plaintext hashes MUST NOT appear in the account-data key.
Encrypted client search-index manifest keyed by an HMAC-derived realm_key.

Controller-owned encrypted draft created when Principal Server materializes an agent's ak.agent.draft.propose / ak.agent.action_request after capability / policy / accountability / risk check. Draft MUST NOT enter shared Realm history; publishing produces a new shared event referencing only an opaque digest. See private-objects.md §4.1.

Controller-private per-context Sidecar hosted-view state. Synchronizes display_mode (context_merged or sidecar_only), pin/collapse state, and HLC without changing either Strand, Track, access, read, watch, notification, or search state.

Controller-owned per-scope agent participation selection (reply / accept_third_party_mention / act_on_behalf). scope_key is realm:<realm_uuid> | circle:<realm_uuid>:<circle_uuid> | strand:<realm_uuid>:<strand_uuid>. Effective participation = immutable provision-derived ceiling ∩ deployment/Realm/Circle/Strand governance ceiling ∩ selection. Realm governance cannot restore a bit omitted at provision time. accept_third_party_mention drives the dispatcher mention gate; reply / act_on_behalf materialize into ak.capability.grant. See zh/models/private-objects.md §4.1.
Actor-private quarantine inbox for invites held by consent gate default profile; MUST NOT expose contactability signals to the inviter.
